Subject: Great meeting at Inference Summit — Quick follow-up

Hi Samantha —

It was great meeting you at the Inference Summit today. Really enjoyed hearing about EdgeAI's plan to roll out real-time anomaly detection at the edge — the latency and cost constraints you mentioned (sub-50ms p90, low memory devices) line up with a few customers we've helped recently.

Quick recap from our chat:
- Primary workload: streaming sensor telemetry + on-device scoring, occasional cloud-batched re-training.
- Constraint: <50ms p90 inference at 512 tokens, device memory & bandwidth limited.
- Priority: proof-of-concept for 3 pilot sites in Q2, production in Q3 if POC meets perf and cost targets.

Next suggested steps from our side:
1) 30–45m technical discovery with one of our solutions engineers to capture performance targets and current infra details.
2) Lightweight config + costing proposal for POC (including quantization and edge-friendly model variants).
3) Optional pilot kit (two-week trial on dedicated capacity) to validate SLOs.

I've attached a short deck that summarizes our edge inference approach and a draft proposal outline. If you agree, how does next week look for a 30m discovery? I can bring Aditya (SE) to map out the technical checklist.

Thanks again for the conversation — excited to explore this with you.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
